title: Orca vs Great White Shark — Who Wins?
description: A killer whale against a great white shark. SeaWorld reports the largest recorded male killer whale at 32 ft and 22,000 lbs; NOAA lists white sharks at up to 4,500 pounds and up to 21 feet (adult). In a tagging study, brief visits from killer whales displaced white sharks from a shared hunting site. Hypothetical matchup.
